D/ DN CONSTAN TIVS PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), Lyons mint fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Not found in RIC vol. 8 under Lyons mint. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN CONSTAN TIVS PF AVG.
